group_definition: initial top-metal-layer three-row Cu/Au composition, nearest fractional-y row; cyclic row windows and 0.6 A clustering in tools.study_design; not a relaxed adsorption binding-site label
outer: leave each observed local motif out completely; separate from frozen configuration folds
inner: 3 grouped configuration folds within outer training for thresholds only
recipe: predeclared DCT16 independent Extra Trees, 32 trees, min leaf2, balanced class weights, threshold grid inherited from scientific_extensions; no outer-score feature/model selection
predictors: surface-layer spectrum only, same 8976-9027 eV crop as extensions; no motif/count/name/graph predictors
sparse_groups: CuAu2 has one held-out configuration; report count and avoid general population claims
independence: same repeatedly examined cohort, not prospective confirmation or ancestral-parent transfer
